resources.string: Installs Magisk modules while the VM is off, without the Magisk daemon: the module\'s system files are written into the guest for real, every replaced file is backed up, and a ledger records all of it, so disabling a module puts the original files back and uninstalling leaves nothing behind. Boot scripts of enabled modules run at boot. Zygisk parts, sepolicy.rule and customize.sh are not supported and are called out in the install report.
The VM is running: stop it to install, enable, disable or remove modules.
